name: Arrival Acknowledgement - Department
description:
{{ candidate_name }} arrives on {{ arrival_date }}.

{% if department == 'Transportation' %}Kindly arrange Airport Pick Up accordingly, then confirm the arrival.{% elif department == 'General Services' %}Kindly arrange accommodation accordingly and confirm the date and time for GS Orientation.{% elif department == 'Finance' %}Kindly arrange 30 KD as Loan Amount for the arriving employee.{% elif department == 'Warehouse' %}Kindly arrange the uniforms and welcome kit accordingly.{% elif department == 'Operations' %}Kindly arrange shifts and confirm the date and time for Operations Orientation.{% endif %}

Please acknowledge Arrival Acknowledgement {{ name }} once done.
assign_condition: status == "Not Acknowledged" or (department == "Transportation" and not arrival_confirmation)
